selection_objective: mean(log(wealth / same_engine_buy_hold_wealth) - 0.75 * max_drawdown - 0.002 * max(0, orders_per_year - 20)); ties fewer fills then smaller candidate index
structural_hypothesis: Risk must be attached to the owned security rather than automatically vetoed by unrelated weak pool members. Downside semideviation distinguishes negative shocks from upward volatility. Stock-specific causal cooldown/recovery prevents immediate repurchase after an alarm. Compare persistent ownership against ranked replacement. The optional broad guard covers only synchronized acute shocks.
interpretation: New authorized retrospective research, after failed ownership experiment; old protocol/results unchanged. 2026 already known and not used for numerical selection. Additional search and architecture selection increase overfitting risk. No risk-free or arbitrary-subset guarantee.
promotion: Preserve all 48 candidates, failures, exact execution/data/cost definitions and source identities. An improved research candidate is not automatically economically accepted or live-deployable.
